data.name: Gurfaah
data.gender_notes: Gurfaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who brings light to the heart and illuminates it. The name Gurfaah carries the meaning “Light of the heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Gurfaah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gurfaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurfaah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: غرفة
in_arabic.meaning: الغرفة تعني المكان أو الحيز الداخلي
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم غرفة مشتق من الجذر العربي غ-ر-ف، ويشير إلى المكان أو الحيز الداخلي، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصفي للجنة والجنات، يدل على مكانة عالية ومرتبة رفيعة في الجنة، وغرفة في الأصل تعني المكان الضيق أو الحيز الصغير لكن في الاصطلاح القرآني والتفسيلي يرمز إلى النعيم والراحة

in_urdu.name: گرفہ
in_urdu.meaning: گرفہ کا مطلب ہے اندرونی جگہ یا حیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: گرفہ نام عربی جڑ غ-ر-ف سے نکلا ہے، جو اندرونی جگہ یا حیز کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر جنت اور جنات کے سیاق میں وصفی طور پر ہوا ہے، جو جنت میں ایک بلند مقام اور رفیع منزل کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، ابتدائی طور پر غرفة کا مطلب ہے تنگ جگہ یا چھوٹا حیز، لیکن قرآنی اور تفسيری اصطلاح میں یہ نعمت اور آرام کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: गुरफ़ा
in_hindi.meaning: गुरफ़ा का अर्थ है भीतरी स्थान या स्थान
in_hindi.long_meaning: गुरफ़ा नाम अरबी मूल غ-ر-ف से निकला है, जो भीतरी स्थान या स्थान को दर्शाता है, कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख स्वर्ग और स्वर्ग के संदर्भ में वर्णनात्मक रूप से किया गया है, जो स्वर्ग में एक उच्च स्थान और उत्कृष्ट स्थिति की ओर संकेत करता है, मूल रूप से गुरफ़ा का अर्थ है संकरी जगह या छोटा स्थान, लेकिन कुरआनी और व्याख्यात्मक शब्दावली में यह आशीर्वाद और शांति का प्रतीक है

in_english.name: Gurfaah
in_english.meaning: Gurfaah means inner place or private chamber
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gurfaah originates from the Arabic root غ-ر-ف (gh-r-f), which denotes an inner place, private chamber, or enclosed space. In the Quranic context, it alludes to a high station or noble abode in Paradise. Etymologically, the term 'Gurfaah' signifies a place of rest, comfort, or seclusion. Historically, it has been used to describe intimate spaces within homes or sacred areas. Spiritually, Gurfaah symbolizes serenity, peace, and proximity to the divine. The name carries connotations of exclusivity, privacy, and a protected sanctuary. In Islamic tradition, names like Gurfaah are chosen for their beauty and deeper meanings, reflecting parents' aspirations for their child's character and station

data.cultural_impact: The name Gurfaah holds significant cultural meaning, especially during the Islamic celebration of Eid al-Fitr. During this joyous occasion, it is common for family and friends to exchange gifts and substance-filled delicacies called Eid Mubarak. A child given the name Gurfaah could be seen as a beacon of light and joy, symbolically representing that which illuminates our homes, hearts and relationships during this festive time.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Gurfaah symbolizes the guidance and enlightenment given by Allah (God). As believers, we strive to remain aware of His presence and eternal light within us. The name is a reminder that just as the physical sun rises and sets, our spiritual faith and connection to the divine also requires nurturing through daily practice and continued learning. Thus, Gurfaah can be seen as a testament to the journey towards self-improvement, illuminated by the divine wisdom and love of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light of the heart" symbolizes The one who brings light to the heart and illuminates it. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Gurfaah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light of the heart.
